verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Vertex AI as a platform for building agentic AI systems and various MCP servers that let external AI agents call into Google Cloud resources, but neither is a built-in assistant embedded in the Google Cloud console/product that users can delegate their own tasks to. No mention of a Gemini-in-console style assistant or similar in-product delegation feature appears in the pack, so this applicable axis is unsupported by evidence.
